identity_contract: Stable values require exact cross-run content identity. Fresh operation-bound values require exact within-operation content identity and cross-run equality of family, canonical size, classification, validation contexts/count, boundary roles, parent-root memberships, and in-process role; their content digests must differ when operation inputs differ.
decision: VCC-EXP-001B closes under the operation-aware identity contract; requiring cross-run digest equality for fresh operation-bound values would violate their binding.
